# ------------------------------------------------------- fabric / calendar

class Fabric:
    """Periodic optical calendar: phases, slices, drift, anchors, blackouts."""

    def __init__(self, fab):
        self.n = int(fab['n'])
        self.T = int(fab['interval_ns'])
        self.S = int(fab['slice_ns'])
        self.O = int(fab['offset_ns'])
        self.N = self.n
        self.drift = [int(x) for x in fab['drift_ppb']]
        self.heat = [(int(h[0]), int(h[1]), int(h[2]), int(h[3]))
                     for h in fab['heat']]
        self.anchors = [(int(a[0]), int(a[1]), int(a[2]))
                        for a in fab['anchors']]
        self.links = []
        for l in fab['links']:
            e0, e1 = l['ends'][0], l['ends'][1]
            self.links.append((
                (int(e0[0]), int(e0[1]), int(e0[2])),
                (int(e1[0]), int(e1[1]), int(e1[2])),
                (int(l['delay_ns'][0]), int(l['delay_ns'][1])),
                (int(l['defer_rounds'][0]), int(l['defer_rounds'][1])),
            ))
        self.slices = [[int(x) for x in s] for s in fab['slices']]
        self.blackouts = [(int(b[0]), int(b[1]), int(b[2]))
                          for b in fab['blackouts']]
        self.guards = [int(x) for x in fab['guards_ns']]
        self.r = int(fab['reconfig_ns'])
        self.Q = len(self.slices)
        M = self.Q * self.S
        self.P = M // math.gcd(self.T, M)
        P, n = self.P, self.n
        self.V = P * n

        self.slice_of = []
        self.rho_of = []
        for p in range(P):
            t = self.O + p * self.T
            self.slice_of.append((t // self.S) % self.Q)
            self.rho_of.append(t % self.S)
        self.slice_sets = [set(s) for s in self.slices]

        # effective per-phase drift allowance (ppb): base plus heat
        eff = [[self.drift[i] for i in range(n)] for _ in range(P)]
        for (node, s, e, extra) in self.heat:
            for p in range(s, e):
                eff[p][node] += extra
        self.eff = eff
        self.drift_as = [eff[p][i] * self.T for p in range(P) for i in range(n)]

        self.anchor_mask = [False] * self.V
        self.anchor_nodes_by_phase = [[] for _ in range(P)]
        for (node, s, e) in self.anchors:
            for p in range(s, e):
                if not self.anchor_mask[p * n + node]:
                    self.anchor_mask[p * n + node] = True
                    self.anchor_nodes_by_phase[p].append(node)
        self.anchor_cells = [i for i, v in enumerate(self.anchor_mask) if v]

        self.black_mask = [0] * len(self.links)
        for (lid, s, e) in self.blackouts:
            self.black_mask[lid] |= (1 << e) - (1 << s)

        self.flight = []
        for p in range(P):
            row = [0] * 9
            for m in range(1, 9):
                mask = 0
                for j in range(m):
                    mask |= 1 << ((p + j) % P)
                row[m] = mask
            self.flight.append(row)

    def aging(self, node, p, delay, dt):
        """Receiver drift allowance (as) from reception to application."""
        T = self.T
        eff = self.eff
        P = self.P
        total = 0
        end = dt * T
        for j in range(dt):
            lo = j * T
            hi = lo + T
            if lo < delay:
                lo = delay
            if hi > end:
                hi = end
            if hi > lo:
                total += eff[(p + j) % P][node] * (hi - lo)
        return total

    def build_edges(self, cal):
        """All eligible-transfer candidates: (p,src,dst,dt,cost,code,margin).

        margin is the largest guard setting g for which the transfer is
        eligible; the transfer is eligible for guard g iff margin >= g.
        """
        T = self.T
        P = self.P
        edges = []
        for p in range(P):
            s = self.slice_of[p]
            rho = self.rho_of[p]
            for l in self.slices[s]:
                (n0, s0, g0), (n1, s1, g1), delays, defers = self.links[l]
                bm = self.black_mask[l]
                for d in (0, 1):
                    if d == 0:
                        src, dst, gsrc, gdst = n0, n1, g0, g1
                    else:
                        src, dst, gsrc, gdst = n1, n0, g1, g0
                    delay = delays[d]
                    defer = defers[d]
                    margin = min(rho, self.S - rho - delay)
                    if margin < 0:
                        continue
                    m = (delay + T - 1) // T
                    if bm & self.flight[p][m]:
                        continue
                    dt = m + defer
                    cost = (cal.hop[gsrc][gdst]
                            + self.aging(dst, p, delay, dt))
                    edges.append((p, src, dst, dt, cost, 2 * l + d, margin))
        self.edges_all = edges

    def step_info(self, cal, p, i, kind, g):
        """Validate an allowed lineage step from cell (p,i) with given kind.

        Returns (dst_node, dst_phase, cost, dt) or None when not allowed.
        """
        if kind == -1:
            return (i, (p + 1) % self.P, self.drift_as[p * self.N + i], 1)
        if type(kind) is not int or kind < 0:
            return None
        l = kind >> 1
        d = kind & 1
        if l >= len(self.links):
            return None
        if l not in self.slice_sets[self.slice_of[p]]:
            return None
        (n0, s0, g0), (n1, s1, g1), delays, defers = self.links[l]
        if d == 0:
            src, dst, gsrc, gdst = n0, n1, g0, g1
        else:
            src, dst, gsrc, gdst = n1, n0, g1, g0
        if src != i:
            return None
        delay = delays[d]
        defer = defers[d]
        rho = self.rho_of[p]
        if not (rho >= g and rho + delay + g <= self.S):
            return None
        m = (delay + self.T - 1) // self.T
        if self.black_mask[l] & self.flight[p][m]:
            return None
        dt = m + defer
        cost = cal.hop[gsrc][gdst] + self.aging(dst, p, delay, dt)
        return (dst, (p + dt) % self.P, cost, dt)


# ------------------------------------------------- periodic envelope solvers

def solve_bounds(F, g):
    """Minimum error allowance per cell for guard setting g (or None)."""
    N, P, V = F.N, F.P, F.V
    drift = F.drift_as
    adj = [[] for _ in range(V)]
    for (p, src, dst, dt, cost, code, margin) in F.edges_all:
        if margin >= g:
            adj[p * N + src].append((((p + dt) % P) * N + dst, cost))
    dist = [None] * V
    heap = []
    for a in F.anchor_cells:
        dist[a] = 0
        heap.append((0, a))
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    push = heapq.heappush
    pop = heapq.heappop
    while heap:
        c, u = pop(heap)
        if dist[u] != c:
            continue
        p, i = divmod(u, N)
        v = ((p + 1) % P) * N + i
        nc = c + drift[u]
        if dist[v] is None or nc < dist[v]:
            dist[v] = nc
            push(heap, (nc, v))
        for (v2, w) in adj[u]:
            nc = c + w
            if dist[v2] is None or nc < dist[v2]:
                dist[v2] = nc
                push(heap, (nc, v2))
    return dist


def solve_full(F, g):
    """(bound, age, earliest-attainment) and predecessor per cell.

    Labels are lexicographic minima of (error allowance, elapsed age) and,
    among those, the earliest real boundary of an attaining lineage started
    at its earliest anchor boundary.
    """
    N, P, V = F.N, F.P, F.V
    drift = F.drift_as
    adj = [[] for _ in range(V)]
    for (p, src, dst, dt, cost, code, margin) in F.edges_all:
        if margin >= g:
            u = p * N + src
            adj[u].append((((p + dt) % P) * N + dst, cost, dt, code))
    dist = [None] * V
    pred = [None] * V
    heap = []
    for a in F.anchor_cells:
        pa = a // N
        dist[a] = (0, 0, pa)
        heap.append((0, 0, pa, a))
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    push = heapq.heappush
    pop = heapq.heappop
    while heap:
        c, ag, tm, u = pop(heap)
        d = dist[u]
        if d is None or d[0] != c or d[1] != ag or d[2] != tm:
            continue
        p, i = divmod(u, N)
        v = ((p + 1) % P) * N + i
        nc = c + drift[u]
        na = ag + 1
        nt = tm + 1
        dv = dist[v]
        if dv is None or (nc, na, nt) < dv:
            dist[v] = (nc, na, nt)
            pred[v] = (u, -1)
            push(heap, (nc, na, nt, v))
        for (v2, w, dt, code) in adj[u]:
            nc = c + w
            na = ag + dt
            nt = tm + dt
            dv = dist[v2]
            if dv is None or (nc, na, nt) < dv:
                dist[v2] = (nc, na, nt)
                pred[v2] = (u, code)
                push(heap, (nc, na, nt, v2))
    return dist, pred
